verdict.rationale: Groq's API reference page embeds the full OpenAPI document in its payload, so a machine-readable spec does exist and can be extracted from the page source. It is not published as a standalone downloadable file: probes of the openapi.json and swagger.json paths returned 404, and neither llms.txt nor GitHub carries a spec. The llms.txt and markdown docs are adjacent, since they describe the docs rather than the API. Missing for 10: a standalone downloadable OpenAPI file at a stable URL, a spec listed in llms.txt or GitHub, and independent hands-on confirmation that the extracted spec is complete and usable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The Groq API reference embeds the full OpenAPI document
